description: Indication of Dutch box 3 tax on crypto only, for tax years 2025 and 2026: tax-free allowance (doubled with a fiscal partner) → base → fixed deemed return for "other assets" → tax at the box 3 rate. Give either cryptoValueEur (value on 1 January) or holdings (valued at the reference-date prices, like value_portfolio). Other assets, debts and savings are NOT included. Figures from belastingdienst.nl, sources in the answer. Indication only, not tax advice. Nothing is stored.

cryptoValueEur.description: Total value of the crypto in EUR on 1 January of the tax year. Use this or holdings.

holdings.description: Holdings to value first, one line per coin and platform. Use this or cryptoValueEur.

amount.description: Number of coins held on the reference date.

coin.description: Coin ticker, name or slug, case-insensitive, e.g. "BTC", "bitcoin", "eth", "ripple".

platform.description: Exchange platform where the coins were held.

partner.description: true if the person has a fiscal partner for the whole year (doubles the tax-free allowance). Default false.

year.description: Tax year; the value is taken on 1 January of this year.

name: estimate_box3
title: Box 3 indication for crypto
